parameters.content:
## FX digest + unusual-move alert
Schedule (weekdays 08:00 Madrid) or headless: `n8n execute --id hubFxDigest0001`.

1. Frankfurter (ECB reference rates): latest + 30-day history
2. Per pair: 1-day move, 30-day move, **z-score** of the last daily log-return vs the previous 29
3. Flag if `|1d| >= 0.7%` **or** `|z| >= 2` (env-tunable)
4. Digest -> shared notifier (Discord/Slack compatible)

Free, no key. ECB publishes ~16:00 CET on working days, so weekend/holiday gaps are expected.
